integrity: The mathematical argument is an explicit equivariant deformation retraction and Cartan-Leray spectral-sequence calculation; its finite checker corroborates p=7 but does not certify the infinite family. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes at least seven only; a homotopy equivalence rather than a homeomorphism to an open complement; no integral higher homotopy classification; the searched literature does not establish publication priority.
title: Prime-cyclic Kneser neighborhood quotients as crown-graph complements in lens spaces
